title: TrashTweaks
description: A client-side utility mod with totem cursor assist, FPS/TPS/Ping/Coordinates HUD overlays, player health indicator, performance profiles, and a fully customizable HUD editor. Does not automate gameplay.
body:
# Trash Tweaks

## ⚠️ Not a Cheat
This mod does **not** automate gameplay in any way.
It only moves the **mouse cursor** on a technical level.
No auto-clicking, no auto-totem, no unfair advantage.

## ✨ Features
- Totem cursor assist (moves cursor toward Totem of Undying)
- FPS, TPS, Ping, Coordinates HUD overlays
- Player health indicator (2 styles: detailed card & bossbar)
- Performance profiles (Performance / Ultra Performance / Quality)
- Fully customizable HUD editor (drag, reposition, toggle each element)
- Configurable cursor movement delay (0ms–1000ms)
- In-game config menu with rebindable keybind

## ℹ️ Mod Name
The name "Trash Tweaks" is **intentional** — chosen by the developer on purpose.

## 👤 Developer
Made by **EgeTheWind**
